summary: The diff implements all four requirements (REQ-65, REQ-66, REQ-67, REQ-68) substantially. Backend types include audioUrl1/audioUrl2, chunked-upload functions are removed, frontend ChapterForm uses URL text inputs, ChapterPage/AudioPlayer use URL strings directly, chapter.ts and chapterMapper.ts are updated. Minor gaps exist around explicit placeholder text verification and confirmation that audioUploadService files were deleted.

missing_requirements.requirement: Audio 1 URL input must have placeholder 'Audio 1 URL — any link (YouTube, Google Drive, direct, etc.)' and Audio 2 URL input must have placeholder 'Audio 2 URL — any link (YouTube, Google Drive, direct, etc.)'
missing_requirements.reason: The ChapterForm.tsx diff is truncated and does not show the placeholder attribute values for the audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 inputs, so the exact placeholder strings matching the specification cannot be confirmed.

hallucinated_features.description: A backend/migration.mo module was added to handle data migration from the old binary-blob chapter schema to the new URL-based schema.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked to update backend/main.mo types and remove binary audio functions. No migration module was requested in any requirement.
